title: Cosa a mejorar
body:
La app funciona súper bien.
Lo que sí o sí falta
Es un lugar donde puedas poner acciones únicas por ejemplo:
“Hablarle a mi jefe para pedirle aumento” y poner un día de deadline.
Algo que también monitoree acciones únicas que uno suele procasticar
author: Facundo Ajler

title: Buggy Apple Watch Version
body:
I like the app, but the Apple Watch version is so buggy I seriously doubt it is even tested.

The syncing is unreliable, and it usually takes a while for completions logged in the watch to register on the phone. Whenever a task is completed on the watch, it will more often than not show it as not completed for a while, and only sometimes is this solved without requiring to manually complete the task once more. The worst offender in my opinion are the timers. The seconds marker moves way too fast most of the time for some reason. After pausing and unpausing, it will start the timer from zero. Again, this is sometimes only a visual bug but at other times progress is somehow lost and the app loses track of how much time had already passed. These are only some of the bugs I’ve noticed.

I’ve been using the app for well over a year now and I feel compelled to write this review because in that time none of the bugs I’ve encountered were fixed. On the contrary, the Apple Watch version seems to get progressively buggier with each update. I just wish the Apple Watch version had the same quality as the iPhone version, which is excellent and the reason I got the app in the first place.
author: Dwape

title: HORRIBLE
body: Desde que salió Watch OS 10 no sincroniza las tareas entre el IPhone y Apple Watch. Probé eliminando la aplicación de ambos dispositivos, volviendo a creer la tareas de cero (aun perdiendo las estadísticas) y sigue sin funcionar. Sacaron miles de actualizaciones diciendo que solucionan ese error y lo único que hacen es empeorarlo.
